support.host: native Linux glibc; no cross-build or older-glibc portability claim
support.isa_contract: Caller must explicitly request Zicclsm for misaligned accesses; wrapper never appends it.
support.memory_contract: Not a general PMA model. Host must declare/initialize RAM backing first. Architectural stores, fetches, PTE A/D updates and CBO.ZERO do not declare memory. Host RAM and declared sparse RAM are distinct from MMIO; device rejection must not create sparse backing. C++ declaration callers are responsible for selecting RAM, not devices.
support.asan_scope: Optional wrapper plus ABI caller only; upstream archives are not instrumented.
remaining_limits: Legacy packed PMP attributes are unsupported; PA-only callers pass null.
Multi-hart, general ELF loading, sparse LR/SC and vector/event/parameter stubs are not established support.
Disassembly requires caller-owned 128-byte buffers, as in FORCE/fpix.
This lock is provenance and a build contract, not a new full-regression acceptance claim.
